project.name: The Tower of Babel
project.purpose: Canonical polyglot capability registry for Pillars & Pistons and Spiral Engine.

policies.claim_rule: Production claims require build, native tests, cross-language contract tests, benchmark evidence, and artifact digests.
policies.link_rule: Every language must carry primary or official documentation and source/ecosystem references.
policies.smithery_rule: Declared metadata is not published registration; publication requires a real MCP package and registry receipt.
policies.spiral_rule: Declared capabilities are not active pistons until Spiral Engine returns a registration receipt.

languages.name: Python
languages.primary_domain: AI/ML pipelines, document intelligence, automation

w4h.what: Rapidly composes AI, data, automation, and integration workflows.
w4h.where: Document intelligence, orchestration, model evaluation, ETL, CLI tooling.
w4h.when: Choose when iteration speed and ecosystem breadth outweigh native-runtime constraints.
w4h.why: Its scientific, ML, web, and automation ecosystems make it the strongest coordination language for intelligent workflows.
w4h.how: Typed Python, asyncio, dataclasses, packaging, and native-extension boundaries.
